description:
Add minecraft mobs and items

This mod add minecraft mobs/items/blocks not in mineclonia.                                                                                                                                
- This mod add:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
Bogged and Parched  (swamp and desert skeletons);                                                                                                                                                                                           
Pig Variants;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
Copper Armor;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
Copper and Netherite Horse Armor;                                                                                                                                                                                          
Copper lanterns and torch;                                                                                                                                                                                                             
Copper nugget and chains;                                                                                                                                                                                                              
Copper tools;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
Copper bars;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
Torchflower Seeds and plant;                                                                                                                                                                                                       
Resin Blocks and variants;                                                                                                                                                                                                              
Pale Oak wood and variants.                                                                                                                                                                                                         
- WIP:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
Turtle Helmet;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
Sniffer Egg;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
Better spawn eggs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
- Ideas for the next update:

Copper variants (lightning rods, chests);
